newsitem.title: USA: Jitters dent Nasdaq for fourth session in a row.
newsitem.headline: Jitters dent Nasdaq for fourth session in a row.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index held its ground Wednesday, rebounding from four consecutive sessions of losses as the technology sector recovered its footing.
The Nasdaq Composite Index closed the day 3.19 points higher at 1206.24 unofficially on volume of 546 million shares. Decliners nudged out gainers 1933 to 2203.
"The big stocks that had acted badly on previous days turned around today, all toward the upside," said one trader.
Some of the strongest gains were seen in Ascend Communications Inc, which gained 3-5/8 to close at 64-1/8, and 3Com Corp, up 3-1/2 to 66.

But selling pressure continued on smaller cap stocks that have underperformed the market -- as mutual funds dumped losing positions and tightened up their portfolios ahead of the October 31 day of reckoning.
"There was more pressure on the smaller stocks, but the big ones did turn around," the trader said.

The most active issue was Cisco Systems Inc, was up 1/2 to 58-1/8. Intel Corp bounced back 2-1/2 to 106-3/4, Dell Computer Corp recovered 2-13/16 to 78-15/16. U.S. Robotics Corp added 2-1/4 to close at 66-5/8.
